pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who chose your name in most families? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Parents or guardians
   C. A shopkeeper
   D. The police

2. Which verse tells Christians to rejoice in the Lord always? (1 mark)
   A. Philippians 4:4
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Luke 19:5

3. According to Philippians 4:8, what should Christians think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is unkind
   B. Whatever is false
   C. Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   D. Whatever hurts others

4. A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family? (1 mark)
   A. No, it is only a group of neighbours
   B. Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   C. No, only parents and children make a family
   D. Only if they are rich

5. Which parts of the body are private? (1 mark)
   A. The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   B. The feet
   C. The hands
   D. The face

6. What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are? (1 mark)
   A. Machines
   B. Property of strangers
   C. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   D. Toys

7. What did the angel tell Balaam to do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   B. Kill the donkey
   C. Go home forever
   D. Curse Israel

8. In which book of the Bible is the story of Samson found? (1 mark)
   A. Judges
   B. Genesis
   C. Psalms
   D. Luke

9. How can a child trust God when facing a challenge? (1 mark)
   A. Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   B. Ignore the problem
   C. Give up
   D. Blame others

10. What animal attacked Samson near Timnah? (1 mark)
   A. A snake
   B. A young lion
   C. A wolf
   D. A bear

11. Who first told Pharaoh about Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. The baker
   B. Potiphar
   C. A magician
   D. The cupbearer

12. What did God tell Abram to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to Egypt
   B. Build a boat
   C. Stay at home
   D. Leave his country and go to a land God would show him

13. How did Zechariah get his speech back? (1 mark)
   A. After visiting Jerusalem
   B. After a long sleep
   C. After a healing by Jesus
   D. After writing "His name is John"

14. Where was Bartimaeus sitting when Jesus passed? (1 mark)
   A. At a market
   B. On a boat
   C. In the temple
   D. By the roadside near Jericho

15. What does gratitude mean? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Boasting
   C. Showing thanks
   D. Being angry

16. Where were the ten men when they called to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Right beside Him
   B. In their homes
   C. In the temple
   D. At a distance

17. How should people with contagious diseases be treated? (1 mark)
   A. With care and respect
   B. By making fun of them
   C. With rejection
   D. With insults

18. What did Jesus say to the young man? (1 mark)
   A. Go away
   B. Young man, I say to you, get up
   C. Follow me
   D. Be quiet

19. What should you do before going to an unfamiliar place to help someone? (1 mark)
   A. Take valuables
   B. Go secretly
   C. Go at night
   D. Tell your parents or teacher

20. Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Luke 13:18-19
   D. Luke 15:8

21. How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. About three thousand
   B. About thirty
   C. About three hundred
   D. About three

22. What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Where is Jerusalem?
   B. How can someone be born when old?
   C. Who are you?
   D. Who is God?

23. What does it mean to trust someone? (1 mark)
   A. To argue with them
   B. To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   C. To fear them
   D. To hide from them

24. What does being assertive mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being silent
   B. Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   C. Fighting
   D. Being rude

25. What should you do if you broke a cup? (1 mark)
   A. Tell the truth and say sorry
   B. Run away
   C. Blame a sibling
   D. Hide it

26. Who tried to run away from God's task? (1 mark)
   A. Stephen
   B. Daniel
   C. Jonah
   D. Joseph

27. Which action shows obedience to school rules? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving without permission
   B. Keeping the compound clean
   C. Coming late
   D. Fighting

28. Is love only a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. Only in church
   B. Yes
   C. Only for adults
   D. No, it is also a choice and action

29. Why is it important to care for personal items? (1 mark)
   A. They are unimportant
   B. They are free
   C. They last longer and save money
   D. They look bad

30. What should you do when you sin? (1 mark)
   A. Confess, say sorry and put things right
   B. Blame others
   C. Repeat it
   D. Hide it

31. Which is an activity in church? (1 mark)
   A. Playing football inside
   B. Fighting
   C. Selling goods
   D. Praying and singing

32. Which verse mentions activities such as a hymn and a word of instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. 1 Corinthians 14:26
   C. John 3:16
   D. Genesis 1:1

33. What does the word apostle mean? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. One who sits
   C. One who is sent
   D. A fisher

34. Which is a good habit in prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Praying only when scared
   B. Praying only in church
   C. Never praying
   D. Praying morning and evening

35. What does "hallowed" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rich
   B. Loud
   C. Holy
   D. Old

36. The Lord's Prayer can be grouped into praise, provision, pardon and protection. Which idea is about forgiving and being forgiven? (1 mark)
   A. Protection
   B. Praise
   C. Pardon
   D. Provision

37. Which fruit is shown by keeping a promise? (1 mark)
   A. Envy
   B. Anger
   C. Faithfulness
   D. Selfishness

38. Who helps believers to show the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. The Holy Spirit
   B. The king
   C. The neighbour
   D. The market

39. What can help you to build self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Being idle
   B. Ignoring rules
   C. Bad company
   D. Keeping busy with good activities

40. Which is a good use of a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. Chatting with strangers
   B. Listening to a gospel song
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Bullying

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the steps a child can take to turn away from wrong behaviour, using Zacchaeus as an example. (5 marks)

42. Give four benefits of forgiving others. (4 marks)

43. Explain the meaning of "Give us today our daily bread". (3 marks)

44. Describe four dangers of misusing social media. (4 marks)

45. Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example. (4 marks)

46. Explain what it means to say that love is a choice. (4 marks)

47. Name two personal items and one way of caring for each. (2 marks)

48. Explain four ways of showing responsibility at school. (4 marks)

49. Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying. (2 marks)

50. Give three ways of obeying God in daily life. (3 marks)

51. Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians. (3 marks)

52. Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways. (4 marks)

53. Describe how Jesus responded when Bartimaeus called for mercy. (3 marks)

54. Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member. (4 marks)

55. Describe four ways in which a child can stand firm in their Christian faith. (4 marks)

56. Name two things that can defile the body. (2 marks)

57. Name two of the twelve disciples who were brothers. (2 marks)

58. Describe what Jesus did to raise the widow's son. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Parents or guardians
   Parents or guardians usually give a child a name at birth.

2. A — Philippians 4:4
   Philippians 4:4 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always."

3. C — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8 lists true, noble, right, pure and lovely things.

4. B — Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

5. A — The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   Private parts are those covered by underwear.

6. C — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

7. A — Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   God allowed him to go but ordered him to speak only His words.

8. A — Judges
   Judges 13-16 tells about Samson.

9. A — Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   Trust in God shows in prayer and seeking help.

10. B — A young lion
   Judges 14:5 says a young lion came roaring towards him.

11. D — The cupbearer
   The cupbearer remembered Joseph from prison.

12. D — Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   Genesis 12:1 records the call.

13. D — After writing "His name is John"
   His mouth was opened when he wrote the name.

14. D — By the roadside near Jericho
   Mark 10:46 says he was by the roadside.

15. C — Showing thanks
   Gratitude is being thankful.

16. D — At a distance
   They stood at a distance and called out.

17. A — With care and respect
   Jesus showed kindness to those with leprosy.

18. B — Young man, I say to you, get up
   Luke 7:14 records this command.

19. D — Tell your parents or teacher
   Safety comes first when helping.

20. C — Luke 13:18-19
   Luke 13:18-19 contains the parable.

21. A — About three thousand
   Acts 2:41 says about three thousand.

22. B — How can someone be born when old?
   He was puzzled about a second birth.

23. B — To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   Trust means believing someone is reliable.

24. B — Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   Assertive means standing for what is right.

25. A — Tell the truth and say sorry
   Honesty and apology are right.

26. C — Jonah
   Jonah ran away before he obeyed.

27. B — Keeping the compound clean
   Following rules shows responsibility.

28. D — No, it is also a choice and action
   Love is shown in actions.

29. C — They last longer and save money
   Care reduces loss.

30. A — Confess, say sorry and put things right
   1 John 1:9 says God forgives those who confess.

31. D — Praying and singing
   Worship includes prayer and singing.

32. B — 1 Corinthians 14:26
   1 Corinthians 14:26 lists activities in worship.

33. C — One who is sent
   Apostles were sent out with a message.

34. D — Praying morning and evening
   Regular prayer builds faith.

35. C — Holy
   Hallowed be your name means may your name be honoured as holy.

36. C — Pardon
   Pardon means forgiveness.

37. C — Faithfulness
   Faithfulness is loyalty.

38. A — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit grows the fruit.

39. D — Keeping busy with good activities
   Good activities help.

40. B — Listening to a gospel song
   Gospel songs are uplifting.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Admit the wrong; be sorry and tell God; say sorry to the person hurt; put things right as Zacchaeus repaid; decide not to repeat and ask God for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, and a clear link to Zacchaeus.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Peace, restored friendship, freedom from anger, pleasing God, fewer fights.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit up to 4.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to give us what we need each day, such as food. We depend on Him and we thank Him for what we have.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for needs, 1 for food or daily, 1 for thanks or dependence.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Strangers, harmful content, bullying, too much screen time, rumours, sharing private details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each danger up to 4.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: We do not always feel like loving. We can still choose to be kind, like helping someone who annoyed us. Love shows in actions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not always feeling, 1 for choosing kindness, 1 for example, 1 for actions.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Uniform: wash it; exercise book: cover it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with care.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep the class clean, take care of books, obey rules, do assigned duties, return borrowed things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents and teachers, read and follow the Bible, tell the truth, pray, be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." He asked what he wanted, then healed him and told him that his faith had healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping, 1 for asking, 1 for healing.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, say no to wrong, be proud to be a Christian, join a good church group, ask God for courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alcohol, drugs, harmful media, sex outside marriage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Peter and Andrew; James and John.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: He felt compassion, told the woman not to cry, touched the bier and told the young man to get up.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for compassion, 1 for touching the bier, 1 for the command.
